title: energy asault silent aim Open Source
features: silent aim for energy assault open source
script:
local function GetClosest()
    local closestdist = math.huge
    local closesttarget = nil
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    local character = player.Character
    local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not rootPart then return nil end
    
    for _, otherPlayer in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= player then
            local otherChar = otherPlayer.Character
            if otherChar and otherChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local otherRoot = otherChar.HumanoidRootPart
                local distance = (otherRoot.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
                
                if distance < closestdist then
                    closestdist = distance
                    closesttarget = otherChar
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return closesttarget
end

local function hook()
    local Hooked = false;
    repeat
        (function()
            local Reference;
            for _, Function in getgc() do
                if typeof(Function) == "function" and debug.info(Function, "n") == "randomunitvector" then
                    Reference = Function
                end
            end;
            if Reference then
                local RandomUnitVector;
                RandomUnitVector = hookfunction(Reference, function(Spread, Direction)
                    local Target = GetClosest()
                    if Target then
                        local Head = Target:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        if Head then
                            local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera;
                            return (Head.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Unit * 10000
                        end
                    end;
                    return RandomUnitVector(Spread, Direction)
                end)
                Hooked = true
            end
        end)()
        if not Hooked then
            task.wait(1)
        end
    until Hooked
end

game.Players.LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character) -- this check is necessary because the "gunS" script only appears when youre alive but i dont think it works
    task.wait(0.5)
    hook()
end)

if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then
    hook()
end
